stem: What does relatively high alkalinity most directly indicate about a water source?
choices: Higher acid-neutralizing capacity, meaning the source may resist pH change more strongly during adjustment
A higher total dissolved-ion concentration than lower-alkalinity sources under comparable measurement conditions
A lower mineral content that makes the source easier to acidify and less likely to influence nutrient solution chemistry
A more stable root-zone moisture pattern because alkalinity directly controls substrate water-holding capacity
rationale: Alkalinity describes acid-neutralizing capacity. It helps explain why two sources with similar measured pH can require different amounts of acid to produce the same pH change.
